title: Personalized, Fun, Gaudi Experience with Compassionate and Passionate Guide
text: We had a great personalized tour with capable Claudia.  She knew the streets and personalized our tour based on what we had already seen and what we were planning to visit on our own.  She also calibrated our ride to our family's different physical capabilities. It was fun learning from her and talking with her.  We felt like we had a true friend showing us around the sights.
author: marydoodle16

title: A tremendous way to see Barcelona and the treasures of Gaudi.
text: A phenomenal way to see Barcelona. The Gaudi Bike tour had e-bikes in excellent condition and make Barcelona's challenging hills easy.   The best bit of all was out tour guide Agustin (request him if you can). He was extremely knowledgeable and helpful. We covered so much of the city seeing epic Gaudi buildings and learning so much.  We had a planned stop for drinks at a very nice rooftop bar, but give the day and hour it was packed (and there was a private even). author: Discover41525341376

title: Bike tour best way to see Barcelona!
text: We really enjoyed our Gaudi bike tour with Julio! He was friendly, knowledgeable, and ensured we were with him at all times as we navigated Barcelona’s excellent bike path network! I highly recommend the Park Guell tour as the park tickets are all sorted out for you. Julio was such a great guide and as avid bikers we always think it is the best way to see a city. Julio knew some sweet side streets as we rolled down the hill from the park that allowed a glimpse into Barcelona’s neighborhood's. Definitely recommend a tour with this bike company and with Julio!

title: A great adventure
text: Our guide was excellent - very knowledgeable, flexible and fun.  The bikes worked great and it was quite an adventure to make our way through the city up to the park and back.  The biggest challenge was finding the store - some better signs might help.

title: Gauti and beyond
text: Julio went above and beyond is personalizing our tour and he obviously spends time on his own in research on Barcelona. His love for Barcelona and his job is obvious and spills over to the tour itself!

title: Alejandra and Barcelona were fantastic!
text: Alejandra was such a great tour guide. Fully disclosed at the start of the tour it was her first time with the company doing this tour and route but she did such a great job. We cannot believe how much of Barcelona we saw on those bikes. Alejandra always made sure we had enough time at each stop and showed us the best places to view Gaudi’s works and the city. Definitely recommend this tour if you don’t have a lot of time in the city. title: A great way to see Barcelona and appreciate the genius ofg  Antoni Gaudí
text: Riding e-bikes through the city to look at Gaudi landmarks was awesome. Our guide, Julio, was kind and knowledgeable. I especially appreciated how before we began we stopped in a park and he drew a map of the city in the dirt that explained the origins of Barcelona and a brief history of how it grew and became the city that it is today. I went with my wife and 14 year old daughter. It was a great thing to do early in our trip to orient to the city.
